description: This file contains functions for generating demo seed data, including creating mock transactions and alerts, and inserting them into a Supabase database or localStorage fallback. It is used for seeding demo data for a user in a dashboard application.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a deterministic-ish ID string with a prefix, random component, and timestamp.

methods.name: isoDateDaysAgo
methods.description: Returns an ISO date string for a date a specified number of days ago.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects a random element from an array.

methods.name: round2
methods.description: Rounds a number to two decimal places.

methods.name: buildDemoRows
methods.description: Creates mock transaction and alert data for a specific user, with configurable counts.

methods.name: seedToLocalStorage
methods.description: Stores demo data into localStorage as a fallback.

methods.name: generateSampleDataSeed
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to seed demo data into Supabase or falls back to localStorage.
